generator.prompt: Roman army stores stacked in a field camp: wooden barrels, sacks of grain and a row of amphorae standing in a straw-lined wooden frame, partly covered by a leather hide tied down with rope. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

review.scope: Tripo's own render, four views of the final compressed model with a 1.8 m figure for scale (scripts/assets/preview-model.mjs), and the camps in the desktop build at High
review.notes: Barrels, flat-based amphorae and sacks on a straw-lined frame under a hide; one amphora stands apart in front. Flat-based amphorae were made in third-century Gaul, among others. In the rest of G3, Chapter IX's Follow camera showed the barrels, amphorae and sacks crumpled into facets at 3,163 triangles, the least processing reaches; processed again at 5,500 (5,389 triangles, 329,212 bytes), they hold, as at 6,859 and 8,819, which Chapter VII's web room could not take.
